## Figure B1.3.1: Number of Low-, Middle-, and High-Income Countries Covered in International Debt Report 2026, by FY27 Income and Lending Groups
Type: stacked bar chart

- **Units:** Number of countries
- **Y-axis:** Number, from **0 to 60**
- **X-axis categories:** **IDA-only countries**, **Blend countries**, **IBRD-only countries**
- **Legend / series:**
  - **Low-income**
  - **Middle-income**
  - **High-income**
- **Time/classification reference:** **FY27** income and lending groups
- **Coverage context from text:** distribution of the **119 low- and middle-income countries and Guyana** included in *International Debt Report 2026* by income and lending groups

### Values shown on bars

| Lending group | Low-income | Middle-income | High-income | Total |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| IDA-only countries | 23 | 30 | 1 | 54 |
| Blend countries | 0 | 19 | 0 | 19 |
| IBRD-only countries | 0 | 47 | 0 | 47 |

### Visual findings
- **Largest total:** **IDA-only countries (54)**, followed by **IBRD-only countries (47)**, then **Blend countries (19)**.
- **Low-income countries** appear **only** in **IDA-only countries**: **23**.
- **High-income countries** appear **only** in **IDA-only countries**: **1**.
- **Middle-income countries** are present in all three lending groups:
  - **IDA-only:** 30
  - **Blend:** 19
  - **IBRD-only:** 47
- **Largest single segment:** **Middle-income in IBRD-only countries (47)**.
- **Smallest nonzero segment:** **High-income in IDA-only countries (1)**.
- **Blend countries** consist entirely of **middle-income countries**.
- **IBRD-only countries** consist entirely of **middle-income countries**.

**Sources:** World Bank Group, “World Bank Country and Lending Groups,” https://datahelpdesk.worldbank.org/knowledgebase/articles/906519-world-bank-country-and-lending-groups; World Bank Group IDA, https://ida.worldbank.org/en/home.  

**Note:** IBRD = International Bank for Reconstruction and Development; IDA = International Development Association; FY = fiscal year.
